parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.characters_present, s.emotional_tone, ch.id AS shot_id, ch.shot_number, ch.description, ch.duration_seconds, ch.dialogue_in_shot FROM projects p JOIN shots ch ON p.id = ch.project_id JOIN scenes s ON ch.scene_id = s.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state IN ('shot_planned', 'fight_choreographed', 'emotion_directed', 'prompted', 'generating') AND ch.state != 'voiced' AND (ch.description IS NOT NULL AND ch.description != '') ORDER BY s.scene_number, ch.shot_number
SELECT c.id AS character_id, c.name, c.voice_profile, c.description FROM characters c WHERE c.project_id = $1

INSERT INTO jobs (job_type, shot_id, project_id, narration_text, voice_id, voice_params, narration_type, priority, estimated_audio_duration, state, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9, $10, NOW())
UPDATE projects SET state = 'voiced', voice_jobs_count = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'voice_jobs_created', $2::jsonb, NOW())
